## Purpose

This work documents the intital version of the constraint set needed to strategize fisher habitat requirements. The following describes the range, habitat zone, territories and critical habitat used to characterize these requirements.

**Range** includes the natural resource districts:

*	Coast: Sea to Sky, Sunshine Coast, Campbell River, North Island – Central Coast

*	North: Mackenzie, Stuart Nechako, Prince George, Coast Mountains, Nadina

* South: 100 Mile House, Cariboo – Chilcotin, Quesnel, Rocky Mountain, Selkirk, Cascades, Okanagan Shuswap, Thompson Rivers

**Habitat zone** the area that is within the range of fishers and is located in a biogeoclimatic zones or subzone. **Territory** means the area providing a female fisher with all her habitat requirements. Size requirements vary by fisher habitat zone
```{r, constraints}
knitr::kable(rbindlist(list(data.table(habitat_zone=c('sub-boreal Habitat Zone: Moist or wet'),bec_zone=c('SBS','SBS','SBS','SBS'), subzone=c('wk','mk','mm','mw'), territory_size=50), data.table(habitat_zone=c('Sub-boreal Habitat Zone: Dry'),bec_zone=c('SBS','SBS','SBS'), subzone=c('dw','dh','dk'), territory_size=25),data.table(habitat_zone=c('Dry Forest Habitat Zone'),bec_zone=c('SBPS','SBPS','SBPS','SBPS', 'IDF', 'IDF', 'IDF','IDF','IDF', 'MS','MS','MS','MS','MS','MS'), subzone=c('xc','mc','dc','mk','dk','dc','mw','dw','ww','xc','xk','dv','dm','dk','dc'), territory_size=30))))
```

**Critical habitat** includes the following categories:
```{r, categories}
knitr::kable(data.table(critical_habitat = c('Reproductive Denning Habitat', 'Resting Habitat: Rust broom sites', 'Resting Habitat: Cavity sites', 'Resting Habitat: Coarse woody habitat','Movement Habitat'),description = c('Cavities required to successfully give birth and rear young', 'Secure locations required during daily activity bouts', 'Secure locations required during daily activity bouts','Secure locations required during daily activity bouts','Required to safely travel between important habitats within and between territories')) )
```

Fisher habitat requirements must meet the following constraints:

* Within a 12-year period the net area of harvesting within a fisher territory can not exceed 10%. **This will be modelled in CLUS as per each fisher territory the age <= 12 years must be less than equal to 10%** 

* The total area each habitat category affected by the cutblocks does not fall below that values described below within the area related to the cutblocks.**This will be modelled in CLUS as per each fisher territory as area not eligible for harvesting in a given time period that meets these conditions**

```{r, cutblock_area}
knitr::kable(data.table(habitat_zone=c('sub-boreal Habitat Zone: Moist or wet'),critical_habitat=c('Reproductive Denning Habitat', 'Resting Habitat: Rust broom sites', 'Resting Habitat: Cavity sites', 'Resting Habitat: Coarse woody habitat','Movement Habitat'),attribute=c('age','age','height', 'age'), type=c('ge'), threshold=c(125,135,35,135), percentage =c(4.9, 21.9, 0.2, 28.2, 61.2)))
```

* Meet the minimum reserve tree requirements in fisher habitat zones are as follows (Insert Table here). If minimum reserve tree requirements cannot be met within the stand the deficiencies will be made up by the next largest available tree to provide for recruitment.


## Spatial Data

The spatial layer that outlines the fisher territories was provided by Rich Weir.`ogr2ogr -f PostgreSQL PG:"dbname=xxxxxx port = xxxx user=xxxxxx password=xxxxxx" D:\Data\Fisher\xxxxx.shp -overwrite -progress --config PG_USE_COPY YES -nlt PROMOTE_TO_MULTI -lco precision=NO`. Steps to create the spatial input into forestryCLUS.

* Create a territory raster for each of the fisher ranges.

### Forest attributes from VRI

The forest attributes required from the VRI include: age, height, basal area, quadratic mean diameter, crown closure, shrub cover, species and percentages - up to 3.

#### Fisher forest attributes
This id links to polygon level attribution. 
```{r, fsher_veg_comp2019, echo = FALSE}
year = 2021
#Harvest locations year
layer<-getSpatialQuery(paste0("SELECT feature_id, shape FROM public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year, " where bec_zone_code in ('SBS', 'IDF', 'MS', 'SBPS', 'BWBS') "))
```

#### Habitat categories

##### Denning
```{r denning}
#SBS: WET
denning.sbs.wet<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'AC%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'AC%' or  SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'AC%') or (SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'S%' and SPECIES_CD_2 IS NULL)) and PROJ_AGE_1>=125 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=30 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=28.5 and BASAL_AREA>=29.75 and bec_zone_code = 'SBS' and bec_subzone in('wk','mk','mm','mw')"))

#SBS DRY: Act leading, secondary, or tertiary species (or hybrid spruce (Sx) as only species) Crown closure ≥20% QMD_125 ≥28 cm Basal area ≥28 m²/ha Stand age ≥125 years 
denning.sbs.dry<- getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'AC%')  or (SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'AC%') or ( SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'AC%')) or ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'S%') and (SPECIES_CD_2 IS NULL))) and (PROJ_AGE_1>=125) and (CROWN_CLOSURE>=20) and (QUAD_DIAM_125>=28) and (BASAL_AREA>=28) and (bec_zone_code = 'SBS') and (bec_subzone in ('dw','dh','dk'))"))
#DRY FOREST: cottonwood (Act) denning stands:Act leading or secondary species.Stand age ≥135 years 
#Trembling aspen (At) denning stands:At leading or secondary species Stand age ≥135 years
#Douglas-fir (Fd) denning stands:Fd as only species, Crown closure ≥20% QMD_125 ≥34.3 cm, Stand age ≥207 years
denning.dry.for<-getTableQuery(
  paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'A%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'A%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=135) or ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'F%' and SPECIES_CD_2  IS NULL) and PROJ_AGE_1>=207 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=20 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=34.3)) and ((bec_zone_code = 'SBPS' and bec_subzone in('xc','mc','dc','mk')) or (bec_zone_code = 'IDF' and bec_subzone in('dk','dc','mw','dw','ww')) or (bec_zone_code = 'MS' and bec_subzone in('xc','xk','dv','dm','xv', 'dk', 'dc')));"))
#BOREAL
denning.boreal<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'AC%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'AC%' or  SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'AC%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=88 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=19.5 and PROJ_HEIGHT_1>=19) or ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'AT%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'AT%' or  SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'AT%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=98 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=21.3 and PROJ_HEIGHT_1>=22.8)) AND ((bec_zone_code = 'BWBS' AND bec_subzone IN ('dk', 'mw', 'mk', 'wk')) or (bec_zone_code ='SBS' and bec_subzone = 'wk' and bec_variant ='2'));"))

denning<-rbindlist(list(denning.dry.for,denning.sbs.dry, denning.sbs.wet,denning.boreal))
denning<-unique(denning$feature_id)
denning.poly<-layer[layer$feature_id %in% denning,]
denning.poly$denning<-1
denning.ras <-fasterize::fasterize(denning.poly, prov.rast, field = "denning") 
denning.ras[is.na(denning.ras[])]<-0
writeRaster(denning.ras, file="C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/habitat_categories/denning_fm.tif", format="GTiff", overwrite=TRUE)
```
##### Resting: Rust Brooms
The following queries specify the forest structure needed for resting sites
```{r, rust_brooms}
#SBS: WET. Hybrid spruce (Sx) leading, secondary, or tertiary species. Crown closure ≥30% QMD_125 ≥22.7 cm Basal area ≥35 m²/ha Stand age ≥135 years Stand height ≥23.7 m
rest.rust.sbs.wet<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'S%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'S%' or  SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'S%') and CROWN_CLOSURE>=30 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=22.7 and BASAL_AREA>=35 and PROJ_HEIGHT_1>=23.7 and bec_zone_code = 'SBS' and bec_subzone in('wk','mk','mm','mw');"))

#SBS DRY: Sx leading, secondary, or tertiary species Crown closure ≥25% QMD_125 ≥19.6 cm Basal area ≥32 m²/ha Stand age ≥72 years
rest.rust.sbs.dry<- getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'S%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'S%' or SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'S%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=72 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=25 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=19.6 and BASAL_AREA>=32 and bec_zone_code = 'SBS' and bec_subzone in ('dw','dh','dk')"))

#DRY FOREST:Sx leading, secondary, or tertiary species Crown closure ≥40% QMD_125 ≥20.1 cm Stand age ≥83 years
rest.rust.dry.for<-getTableQuery(paste0(
  "select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'S%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'S%' or SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'S%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=83 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=40 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=20.1) and ((bec_zone_code = 'SBPS' and bec_subzone in('xc','mc','dc','mk')) or (bec_zone_code = 'IDF' and bec_subzone in('dk','dc','mw','dw','ww')) or (bec_zone_code = 'MS' and bec_subzone in('xc','xk','dv','dm', 'xv', 'dk', 'dc')));"))
  
#BOREAL
rest.rust.boreal<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where (((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'SW%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'SW%' or SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'SW%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=78 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=50 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=18.5 and PROJ_HEIGHT_1>=19 and BASAL_AREA>=31.4) or ((SPECIES_CD_1 LIKE 'SB%'  or SPECIES_CD_2 LIKE 'SB%' or SPECIES_CD_3 LIKE 'SB%') and PROJ_AGE_1>=68 and CROWN_CLOSURE>=35 and QUAD_DIAM_125>=17 and PROJ_HEIGHT_1>=14.8)) and ((bec_zone_code = 'BWBS' and bec_subzone in ('dk', 'mw', 'wk')) or (bec_zone_code ='SBS' and bec_subzone = 'wk' and bec_variant ='2'))"))

rest.rust<-rbindlist(list(rest.rust.dry.for,rest.rust.sbs.dry, rest.rust.sbs.wet,rest.rust.boreal))
rest.rust<-unique(rest.rust$feature_id)
rest.rust.poly<-layer[layer$feature_id %in% rest.rust,]
rest.rust.poly$rust<-1
rest.rust.ras <-fasterize::fasterize(rest.rust.poly, prov.rast, field = "rust") 
rest.rust.ras[is.na(rest.rust.ras[])]<-0
writeRaster(rest.rust.ras, file="C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/habitat_categories/rest_rust_fm.tif", format="GTiff", overwrite=TRUE)
```

##### Movement habitat
The following queries specify the forest structure needed for movement
```{r, movement}
#SBS_WET. Total cover ≥50% (≥30% shrub and ≥20% tree cover)
#shrub cover max 30%
movement.sbs.wet<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where CROWN_CLOSURE is not null and ((CROWN_CLOSURE>30) OR (SHRUB_CROWN_CLOSURE is not null and CROWN_CLOSURE> 10 and ((SHRUB_CROWN_CLOSURE + CROWN_CLOSURE) > 30))) and basal_area > 0 and bec_zone_code = 'SBS' and bec_subzone in('wk','mk','mm','mw')"))

#SBS-DRY. Total cover ≥50% (≥30% shrub and ≥20% tree cover)
movement.sbs.dry<-getTableQuery(paste0("select feature_id from public.veg_comp_lyr_r1_poly",year," where CROWN_CLOSURE is not null and ((CROWN_CLOSURE>25) OR (SHRUB_CROWN_CLOSURE is not null and CROWN_CLOSURE> 10 and ((SHRUB_CROWN_CLOSURE + CROWN_CLOSURE) > 25))) and basal_area > 0 and bec_zone_code = 'SBS' and bec_subzone in ('dw','dh','dk')"))
```

#### Make territories and apply density
```{r, hex_grid}
fetas<-st_read("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/habitat_categories/feta_time.shp")
fisher.density<-read.csv("C:/Users/klochhea/fetaMapper/data-raw/habitat_categories/feta_density.csv")

hex.grid<-merge(fetas, fisher.density, by = "fid")

ogma.ras<-raster("ogma.tif")
ogma.ras[is.na(ogma.ras[])]<-0

defer.ras<-raster("defer.tif")
defer.ras[is.na(defer.ras[])]<-0

thlb.ras<-raster("thlb2020.tif")
thlb.ras[is.na(thlb.ras[])]<-0

#habitat
cav.ras<-raster("rest_cavity_fm.tif")
rust.ras<-raster("rest_rust_fm.tif")
den.ras<-raster("denning_fm.tif")
mov.ras<-raster("movement_fm.tif")
cwd.ras<-raster("rest_cwd_fm.tif")
open.ras<-raster("open_fm.tif")

den.cav.ras<-cav.ras+den.ras
den.cav.ras[den.cav.ras[] > 1]<-1
writeRaster(den.cav.ras, "den_cav.tif", overwrite= T)
#Overlap
den.overlap.ogma<-den.ras*ogma.ras
den.overlap.defer<-den.ras*defer.ras
den.overlap.defer.thlb<-den.ras*defer.ras*thlb.ras

mov.overlap.ogma<-mov.ras*ogma.ras
mov.overlap.defer<-mov.ras*defer.ras
mov.overlap.defer.thlb<-mov.ras*defer.ras*thlb.ras

den.cav.overlap.ogma<-den.cav.ras*ogma.ras
writeRaster(den.cav.overlap.ogma, "den_cav_ovlp_ogma.tif", overwrite= T)
den.cav.overlap.defer<-den.cav.ras*defer.ras
writeRaster(den.cav.overlap.defer, "den_cav_ovlp_defer.tif", overwrite= T)
den.cav.overlap.defer.thlb<-den.cav.ras*defer.ras*thlb.ras

rust.overlap.ogma<-rust.ras*ogma.ras
rust.overlap.defer<-rust.ras*defer.ras
rust.overlap.defer.thlb<-rust.ras*defer.ras*thlb.ras

#Add in habitat categgoires to break any ties
hex.grid$hab_den<- exactextractr::exact_extract(den.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$hab_rus<- exactextractr::exact_extract(rust.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$hab_cav<- exactextractr::exact_extract(cav.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$hab_cwd<- exactextractr::exact_extract(cwd.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$hab_mov<- exactextractr::exact_extract(mov.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$hab_opn<- exactextractr::exact_extract(open.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$ogma<- exactextractr::exact_extract(ogma.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$defer<- exactextractr::exact_extract(defer.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$thlb<- exactextractr::exact_extract(thlb.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))

openess.ras<-raster("openess.tif")
wetlands.ras<-raster("wetland.tif")
wetlands.ras[is.na(wetlands.ras[])]<-0
openess.ras[is.na(openess.ras[])]<-0
openess.ras2<- openess.ras + wetlands.ras
openess.ras2[openess.ras2[]> 1]<-1

hex.grid$openess<- exactextractr::exact_extract(openess.ras2,hex.grid,c('sum'))
hex.grid$openess_max<- exactextractr::exact_extract(wetlands.ras,hex.grid,c('sum'))

#Calculate the number of habit requirement
hab_crit<-data.table(st_drop_geometry(hex.grid))
hab_crit[is.na(hab_den), hab_den:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(hab_rus), hab_rus:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(hab_cav), hab_cav:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(hab_cwd), hab_cwd:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(hab_mov), hab_mov:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(hab_opn), hab_opn:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(thlb), thlb:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(ogma), ogma:=0]
hab_crit[is.na(defer), defer:=0]

#out4$hab_chr<-as.integer(out4$hab_chr)
hab_crit$nfish<-round(hab_crit$nfish, 4)
hab_crit$p_occ<-exp(-0.219*((hab_crit$openess/3000)*100))/(1+exp(-0.219*((hab_crit$openess/3000)*100)))/0.5
hab_crit$p_occ_max<-exp(-0.219*((hab_crit$openess_max/3000)*100))/(1+exp(-0.219*((hab_crit$openess_max/3000)*100)))/0.5

#calculate abundance
hab_crit$abund<-hab_crit$nfish*hab_crit$p_occ
hab_crit$abund_pot<-hab_crit$nfish*hab_crit$p_occ_max
sum(hab_crit$abund, na.rm=T)

fish.constraints0<-merge( hex.grid[c("fid", "geometry")],hab_crit, by.x = 'fid', by.y = 'fid', all.x = TRUE)
st_write(fish.constraints0, "feta_v0.shp", overwrite= T, append =F)
```

###Calculate d2
```{r, d2}
fish.constraints1<-sf::st_read("feta_v0.shp")
#get the fisher population
fetaid<-data.table( fid = fasterize::fasterize(fish.constraints1, prov.rast, field = "fid")[],mov_p = raster("movp.tif")[])
fetaid<-fetaid[mov_p>0,]
freq_fetaid<-fetaid[ ,.(count = .N), by = c("fid", "mov_p")]
feta_pop<-freq_fetaid[freq_fetaid[, .I[which.max(count)], by = fid]$V1]

#get table of information
d2_est<-fish.constraints1 %>% st_drop_geometry()
d2_est<-data.table(d2_est)
d2_est<-merge(d2_est, feta_pop, by.y = "fid", by.x = "fid")

#get the cov
# 1: SBS-moist, 2: SBS-dry, 3: dry forest, 5: boreal
fisher.d2.cov <- list(matrix(c(0.536,	2.742,	0.603,	3.211,	-2.735,	1.816,	2.742,	82.721,	4.877,	83.281,	7.046,	-21.269,	0.603,	4.877,	0.872,	4.033,	-0.67,	-0.569,	3.211,	83.281,	4.033,	101.315,	-15.394,	-1.31,	-2.735,	7.046,	-0.67,	-15.394,	56.888,	-48.228,	1.816,	-21.269,	-0.569,	-1.31,	-48.228,	47.963), ncol =6, nrow =6),
                           matrix(c(0.525,	-1.909,	-0.143,	2.826,	-6.891,	3.264,	-1.909,	96.766,	-0.715,	-39.021,	69.711,	-51.688,	-0.143,	-0.715,	0.209,	-0.267,	1.983,	-0.176,	2.826,	-39.021,	-0.267,	58.108,	-21.928,	22.234,	-6.891,	69.711,	1.983,	-21.928,	180.113,	-96.369,	3.264,	-51.688,	-0.176,	22.234,	-96.369,	68.499), ncol =6, nrow =6),
                           matrix(c(2.905,	0.478,	4.04,	1.568,	-3.89,	0.478,	0.683,	6.131,	8.055,	-8.04,	4.04,	6.131,	62.64,	73.82,	-62.447,	1.568,	8.055,	73.82,	126.953,	-130.153,	-3.89,	-8.04,	-62.447,	-130.153,	197.783), ncol=5, nrow=5),
                           matrix(c(193.235,	5.418,	42.139,	125.177,	-117.128,	5.418,	0.423,	2.926,	5.229,	-4.498,	42.139,	2.926,	36.03,	46.52,	-42.571,	125.177,	5.229,	46.52,	131.377,	-101.195,	-117.128,	-4.498,	-42.571,	-101.195,	105.054), ncol =5, nrow =5))

d2_est[, denning:= (hab_den/3000)*100]
d2_est[, cavity:= (hab_cav/3000)*100]
d2_est[, rust:= (hab_rus/3000)*100]
d2_est[, cwd:= (hab_cwd/3000)*100]
d2_est[, mov:= (hab_mov/3000)*100]
d2_est[, opn:= (hab_opn/3000)*100]

d2_est[ mov_p == 1 & denning >= 0, denning:=log(denning + 1)][ mov_p == 1 & cavity >= 0, cavity:=log(cavity + 1)]
d2_est[ mov_p == 2 & denning >= 0, denning:=log(denning + 1)]
d2_est[ mov_p >= 3 & rust >= 0, rust:=log(rust + 1)]
   
#-----Truncate at the center plus one st dev
stdev_pop1<-sqrt(diag(fisher.d2.cov[[1]]))
stdev_pop2<-sqrt(diag(fisher.d2.cov[[2]]))
stdev_pop3<-sqrt(diag(fisher.d2.cov[[3]]))
stdev_pop4<-sqrt(diag(fisher.d2.cov[[4]]))
    
d2_est[ mov_p == 1 & denning > 1.57 , denning := 1.57 ][ mov_p == 1 & rust > 36.2, rust :=36.2][ mov_p == 1 & cavity > 0.685 , cavity :=0.685][ mov_p == 1 & cwd > 30.38, cwd :=30.38][ mov_p == 1 & mov > 61.5, mov :=61.5][ mov_p == 1 & opn < 32.7, opn :=32.7]

d2_est[ mov_p == 2 & denning > 1.16, denning := 1.16][ mov_p == 2 & rust > 19.1, rust :=19.1][ mov_p == 2 & cavity > 0.45 , cavity :=0.45][ mov_p == 2 & cwd > 12.7, cwd :=12.7][mov_p == 2 & mov > 51.3, mov :=51.3][ mov_p == 2 & opn < 37.3, opn :=37.3]

d2_est[ mov_p == 3 & denning > 2.3, denning := 2.3][ mov_p == 3 & rust > 1.6, rust :=1.6][ mov_p == 3 & cwd > 10.8, cwd :=10.8][ mov_p == 3 & mov > 58.1, mov := 58.1][ mov_p == 3 & opn < 15.58, opn := 15.58]

d2_est[ mov_p == 5 & denning > 24 , denning:=24 ][ mov_p ==5 & rust > 2.2, rust :=2.2][ mov_p ==5 & cwd > 17.4 , cwd :=17.4][ mov_p ==5 & mov > 56.2, mov :=56.2][ mov_p == 5 & opn < 31.2, opn := 31.2]
    
    
    #-----D2
d2_est[ mov_p == 1, d2:= mahalanobis(d2_est[ mov_p == 1, c("denning", "rust", "cavity", "cwd", "mov", "opn")], c(1.57, 36.2, 0.68, 30.38, 61.5, 32.72), cov = fisher.d2.cov[[1]])]
d2_est[ mov_p == 2, d2:= mahalanobis(d2_est[ mov_p == 2, c("denning", "rust", "cavity", "cwd", "mov", "opn")], c(1.16, 19.1, 0.4549, 12.76, 51.25, 37.27), cov = fisher.d2.cov[[2]])]
d2_est[ mov_p == 3, d2:= mahalanobis(d2_est[ mov_p == 3, c("denning", "rust", "cwd", "mov", "opn")], c(2.31, 1.63, 10.8, 58.1, 15.58), cov = fisher.d2.cov[[3]])]
d2_est[ mov_p == 5, d2:= mahalanobis(d2_est[ mov_p == 5, c("denning", "rust", "cwd", "mov", "opn")], c(23.98, 2.24, 17.4, 56.2, 31.2), cov = fisher.d2.cov[[4]])]


d2_est[ denning < 0.001, d2:= NA][mov < 0.001,  d2:= NA][cwd  < 0.001,  d2 := NA][rust  < 0.001,  d2 := NA]

fish.constraints2<-merge(fish.constraints1, d2_est[,c("fid", "d2")], by.x = "fid", by.y = "fid", all.x = TRUE)
st_write(fish.constraints2, "feta_v1.shp", overwrite= T, append =F)
```
